These latter compounds are known to interact with the same transporter, implying a possible pathway where the initial compound may influence the transporter through its interaction with these secondary targets. The scores from the paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the exact mechanism of interaction remains unclear. The evidence suggests that the compound may act as a modulator or inhibitor of the transporter, but further experimental validation is required to confirm this hypothesis.
